We’re looking for passionate, analytically strong Product Specialists and Managers who want to take ownership of designing, developing, and improving mobile games played by millions. This is a hands-on role where you’ll shape product strategy, translate player insights into better experiences, and work closely with cross-functional teams to bring ideas to life.
